description: Fork of exp043 (dominance residual stream). Stream is kept UNCANONICALISED throughout the layer stack — accumulating raw Borda-vote sums in P=2016 space. Each block reads via D2V (linear Borda projection + LayerNorm) on the raw stream, runs Q/K/V/SDPA/out_proj, and adds its raw dominance output back to the stream. canonicalise is applied ONLY at the very end before the Linear unembedder. Tests whether preserving Borda-sum magnitudes across layers (instead of quantising to ±1 at every layer's residual add) helps convergence — block sees consensus strength, not just rank profile.
